title: Settings\Woopoly Features and Meta List - current status
body:
This issue is a reference note to answer questions about the Settings and any outstanding issues.

## Features
- [x] **Fields Locker**	Fields locker makes it easy for user to know which field to translate and which to ignore: working as of 0.26
- [x] **Emails**	Use order language whenever WooCommerce sends order emails: working in 0.26, improved in 0.30 release candidate with more options and more email types covered
- [x] **Reports**	Enable reports language filtering and combining: implemented: if turned off, shows all results, if turned on, use language filter to filter results (not sure this is working 100% correct)
- [x] **Coupons Sync**	Apply coupons rules for product and its translations: if On, Usage Restrictions by Products and Categories also apply to the translations of any selected Products and Categories:  if off then only the selected terms will be considered
- [x] **Stock Sync**	This only affects impact of basket and orders on stock.  If turned off, the Stock class is not loaded, however this alone _may not give the expected results_ since the Stock Metas are also synchronised via the Metas List, Stock Metas.  
**Note: If the Stock Sync is turn off but the Stock Metas sync is left on, then new orders will only affect stock in current language, however if the product is saved then the Stock will be synchronized for all languages again.**
- [x] **Translate Categories**	Enable categories translations: working, if turned off, categories are available in all languages 
- [x] **Translate Tags**	Enable tags translations: working, if turned off, tags are available in all languages 
- [x] **Translate Attributes**	Enable attributes translations:  turns translation on or off for all Products\Attributes
- [x] x **Translate Shipping Classes**	Enable shipping classes translations (**not supported for WooCommerce versions >= 2.6**)  [in any case these are not normally visible to the customer?]
- [ ] ? **Translation Downloader**	Download WooCommerce translations when a new polylang language is added  _(not retested, but no changes expected.  Was fixed in 0.29.1)_

Issues:

- [x] Translate Product Categories, Product Tags and Attributes are also added to Polylang Languages\Settings\Custom Taxonomies, however Hyyan settings take precedence, and individual Attributes settings under Custom taxonomies have no effect.
- [x] check variation stock synchronization fixes for WooCommerce 3.0 obey settings
- [x] Hyyan Features/Stock Sync should take precedence over detail settings?  or at least show a warning on the Settings\Features page (added warning)

## Metas List

### General Metas

- [x] Product-type
- [x] Virtual
- [x] Downloadable
- [x] Sku
- [x] Regular Price
- [x] Sale Price
- [x] Sale Price Dates From
- [x] Sale Price Dates To
- [ ] Downloadable Files  -  Downloads functionality not yet re-tested
- [ ] Download Limit
- [ ] Download Expiry
- [ ] Download Type
- [ ] Menu Order -- **controlled by Polylang Language, Settings, Page order** if disabled in  Polylang it will not be synchronized regardless of woo-poly setting.
- [ ] Comment Status (Enable reviews) - - **controlled by Polylang Language, Settings, Comment Status** if disabled in Polylang synchronization will be disabled regardless of woo-poly setting.
- [x] Upsell Ids
- [x] Crosssell Ids
- [x] Featured - implemented woo3 change from Meta to Taxonomy
- [ ] Thumbnail Id - **controlled by Polylang Language, Settings, Featured image** if enabled in  Polylang it will be synchronized regardless of woo-poly setting.   Not tested, this might allow the opposite, synchronise Product Featured Image but not Post/Page featured image.
- [ ] Price - _price in wp_postmeta is the actual purchase price which is may be equal to _regular_price or _sale price: storing in _price avoids an additional calculation check over _sale_price, _sale_price_dates_from, _sale_price_dates_to	within product loops etc.  It's not so clear the effect of turning on or off synchronisation for this.
- [x] Product Image Gallery
- [ ] Total Sales - not re-tested yet
- [ ] Translation Porduct Type **What does this do??**
- [x] Visibility  - implemented woo3 change from Meta to Taxonomy

### Stock Metas
See note above on Features, Stock.  Stock synchronisation can be turned off if both Features\Stock and the Stock Metas are turned off.  These options can be turned off individually but a more normal use case would be to leave them all on or all off.
- [x] - Manage Stock
- [x] - Stock
- [x] - Backorders
- [x] - Stock Status
- [x] - Sold Individually

### Attributes Metas	

- [x] Product Attributes - **pending more testing**
When this option is selected:
- Custom product attributes defined on the Product are synchronised and not translateable by editing in the secondary language version.
- global Products\Attributes are synchronized
 - if WooPoly\Features\Translate Attributes is OFF
 - if On the synchronisation uses translated term if available or blank if no term available **missing translations will break your variations**
When this option is turned off:
- no attributes are automatically copied between translations
- all attributes are editable 
- Global Select attribute terms are still synchronised, at least when used for variations
- [x] Default Attributes - in a variation product, this is the option which is pre-selected, turning this off allows different pre-selections for different languages

### Taxes Metas	

- [x] Tax Status
- [x] Tax Class
(works, should normally be left on, tax should be driven by country not by language)

### Variables Metas	
_I read there were some changes in WooCommerce 3.x - Not yet specifically retested_
But before testing what is the desirable behaviour?  What would it mean if price synchronization is off but Max/Min price synchronisation is on??  Shouldn't WooCommerce automatically calculate these values when a product is saved?

Issues:
- Variation fields locker does not respect Meta List settings:  fields such as price remain locked even when price synchronization is turned off.  (exception is Variation Description for which a specific change was added now in the woopoly woo3 release candidate)

title: Rewrite Taxonomy and Attribute synchronisation
body:
## Proposal
Rewrite synchronisation as generic loop covering ALL Taxonomies and Attributes that are defined on the Product.

## Rationale
After dealing with most of the WooCommerce 3.0 issues, most the remaining open issues concern synchronisation settings that don't work, synchronisation issues on attributes, synchronisation issues on variations and unexpected/confusing behaviour resulting from the current synchronisation setup. 

The rewrite of Taxonomy and Attribute could be two separate issues, except that WooCommerce is moving attributes to become Taxonomies for example: 

- in WooCommerce 2.6 Shipping class is changed to be taxonomy (fixed for simple products in Hyyan 0.26, fixed for variable products in Hyyan 0.30 release candidate), 
- in WooCommerce 3.0 Product Visibility, Featured and Stock Status are moved to new product_visibility taxonomy.

This breaks the current synchronisation code and the fixed setup of the Hyyan settings options.

## Benefits of generic solution

- simpler code (easier to maintain)
- compatible with changes to WooCommerce etc
- automatic compatibility with 3rd party plugins which add attributes and taxonomies
- simpler options screen: it may be sufficient to allow input boxes allowing list of items to exclude from synchronisation
- current "Settings, WooPoly" partially conflicts with (and overrides) Polylang "Languages, Settings", removing this duplication would reduce user confusion and confusing support calls

### Issues to be addressed:
#148 Catalog Visibility and Featured product not synchronized in WooCommerce 3.x
#127 Text attribute synchronisation
#124 Errors when do not sync some product attributes
#73 Variations sku are sync regardless of the Meta List setting 
#72 How to handle Variable Product attributes with terms withtout translation
#13 deactivate meta synchronisation 
(not a complete list, some issues with custom components etc will also be addressed and of course a lot of queries on the WordPress support forum)

## Requirements (Ideal)

### Synchronisation types:

- **No synchronisation**:  certain taxonomies such as language, term_language and term_translations must not be synchronised since they are controlled by and define the language relationships.  In addition the shop manager should be able to specify additional taxonomies which must not be synchronised.
- **Synchronise**: taxonomy is not translatable, for example Product Type, product_visibility, prices
- **Translate (no default)**:  this is the default action for Product Categories, Product Tags and Product Attributes including Product variation attributes.  This option is very confusing as leads to disappearing terms, invisible products and disappearing variations wherever a term has not been translated yet.  [For example, create a variation product, create a translation, save the translation -> your variations are now deleted if you forgot to translate the variation attributes.]   Proposal is to **remove** this option except for *<temporarily forgot use case>*.
- **Translate (copy base language)**:  where translated term does not yet exist, it is created as a copy of the base language term.  (solution already provided in comment on #78)
- **Translate (machine translation)**:  where translated term does not yet exist, create a machine translated version.  On error fall back to copy base language.

### Settings

If written in a generic way the settings screen could show and allow selection of Synchronisation type for:
- default for new Product Attributes
- default for new Custom Fields
- built-in taxonomies and attributes (as indicated above not all taxonomies support all options)
- Product Attributes: ideally synchronisation setting could be different for individual Product attributes, for example it seems really unnecessary to create translations of numeric fields and ID fields such as ASIN, but an automatic copy base language option could mitigate this.
-list detected additional attributes and fields 

Also there should be an option regarding the handling of new products:

- create Product Translations automatically?  In what Status?
- new Product Translations should be created as:
 - blank (no default translation for Subject, Description, Short Description)
 - copy source text
 - machine translation
 - use current language or base language as source for creating new product?
[if I have already done English and Spanish, I would prefer to machine translate from Spanish into Portuguese, Italian, French, Catalan etc, but for other languages I would prefer to use English as the source.]


## Implementation

Proposed to start first with the Taxonomies.  I have a partial solution in dev.

@hyyan, any thoughts please?

title: When adding new variations, tool should also add the new variation to other languages
body:
Currently when adding a new variation to an existing product, the new variation is NOT added to  other language versions of the product.
To add the new variation in the other language it is necessary to:

1. Open the product in the other language
2. Go to the attributes tab, expand and select the values to add
3. save attributes, save and reload product and the new variation will now appear
... repeat for any additional languages

This is non-obvious behaviour.

Ideally, save in shop language should automatically create any new variations in secondary languages, or show warning where not able to do so (for example because attribute translations are not available).

title: Variation "Save changes" button does not trigger variation synchronization
body:
The Variations tab in Product Data has a "Save changes" button.
This button does an ajax call to save changes on the current product but does NOT currently trigger a synchronization to update translations.

When you press the Update button to save the product, the translations are synchronized at that point.  If you do not press the Update button, the translations will be left in an invalid (unsynchronized) state and continue to show the previous values.

title: Translate Email Recipient field on Shop Email notifications
body:
The email notifications sent to the Shop have a recipient field which could be translatable by hooking:
		$recipient  = apply_filters( 'woocommerce_email_recipient_' . $this->id, $this->recipient, $this->object );

This would have the benefit of allowing a shop to have different email addresses for different languages, so orders in different languages can be automatically routed to different staff.

This affects the email types:

- New Order
- Cancelled Order
- Failed Order

In order to set up different email addresses for different languages, these would need to be entered in the strings translation table, otherwise the emails will continue to be sent to the same address.

title: Automated testing for woo-poly-integration
body:
## Call for Contributions for test pack

How do you test currently?

* Have you reviewed the wooCommerce test packs and thought about extending those?  
* Do you have your own test pack which could be contributed?

WooCommerce has [PHPUnit](https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce/blob/master/tests/README.md) tests and [e2e](https://woocommerce.wordpress.com/2017/03/30/end-to-end-testing-woocommerce/) testing packs which should be extended to woo-poly-integration.

Due to the larger number of different options in WooCommerce, and large number of different translation options, the number of different test cases is too high to repeat manually for each change.  For example there are over 50 checkboxes in the woo-poly settings, some of which would need multiple tests to cover different WooCommerce scenarios (different product types, different WooCommerce settings etc). 
The functionality is also too important not to test as it directly impacts on sales.

Subtle translation synchronisation bugs can escape notice for quite some time, here are some previous examples:

* #136 inventory updated wrong or inconsistent in different languages
*  #90 pricing not updated correctly across variations
*  #112 shipping and #117 attributes not updated correctly across variations
*  #124 unexpected behaviour when turning off synchronization for some attributes

It's easy not to notice that some data hasn't been synchronised correctly: actually opening translated products and checking all the details tabs is very time consuming.
Also there are or have been scenarios where the translation needs to be opened *and saved* in order for the synchronized settings to take effect.

A test pack could help flush out these issues, give greater confidence to the shop owner and save a lot of time in double-checking updates and translations.

title: Using new WC2.7 CRUD method to create/update _translation_porduct_type product meta
body:
Instead of using `update_post_meta()` function to add WooPoly custom product meta used [here](https://github.com/hyyan/woo-poly-integration/blob/woocommerce2.7/src/Hyyan/WPI/Product/Meta.php#L339-L345), we can now use the filter _woocommerce_before_product_object_save_ defined [here](https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce/blob/master/includes/abstracts/abstract-wc-product.php#L1320).

This filter filters the product object (and passes as well the product data_store object) before saving the data to the DB. The data_store object pointer is useful to adjust object props before save.

See this [issue](https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce/issues/12648) for further details.

body:
Enabling Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration causes checkout scripts to be loaded on all pages, for example from the Stripe 
https://checkout.stripe.com/v2/checkout.js?ver=2.0

was incorrectly closed by me - I obfuscated the issue by using Cloudflare RocketLoader javascript delivery.
So this happens on Antonio de Carvalho WooPoly Version 1.0.1 and both previous and current Hyyan versions.

I restested disabling all other plugins apart from:
Polylang	 	by Frédéric Demarle – 2.0.7
Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration	 	by Hyyan Abo Fakher – 0.29
WooCommerce Stripe Gateway	 	by Automattic – 3.0.5
WooCommerce	 	by WooThemes – 2.6.7


In this scenario,
Enabling Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration causes extra checkout scripts to be loaded on all pages.
After disabling Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration again, the checkout scripts are only loaded on the checkout page.

title: How to handle Variable Product attributes with terms withtout translation
body:
**tl;tr**

I have come across the following scenario and need help figuring out what should be the behavior of the plugin in this case.

Scenario:
1. Product attribute with the name "My Attribute" is created. 
1.1. The translation is automatically added to the Polylang Strings Translations page, with the same name for all active languages.
2. The term named "terms1" is added to "My Attribute" in the default language.
3. A variable product titled "My Var Product" is created in the default language with the attribute "My Attribute" used to create variations.
4. A translation of "My Var Product" is created for a second language, named "My Translated Var Product"
4.1. The translation is created with 1 variation and all metas copied except the term slug since the term doesn't have translation. When "My Translated Var Product" is saved/published, Polylang will sync back to the product in default language "My Var Product" and remove the attribute and variation.

Althought he behaiviour is consistent with Polylang own logic, for a new user of WooPoly plugin this may be confusing and doesn't understand that the terms were not translated.

So my question: shall WooPoly create the terms translations with the same name (like for the attribute name - see point 1.1) if a translation is not found? And potentially add some inline js to alert that attribute terms need to be translated?

Alternatively, we can simple add a note to the readme file and FAQ mentioning this as a know issue?
